title: Cargo Capacity Hit 24,327 While Crews Got Smaller
hook: Cargo capacity reached 24,327 while crews kept shrinking.
closing: More of the world's goods now depend on surprisingly few people at sea.
question: Would you crew a ship?

segments.say: The largest ship carries 24,327 container equivalents. Capacity grew more than sixfold from the earliest listed vessel.
The giant vessel stretches 400 meters. Modern cargo ships have outgrown historic passenger liners.
A typical cargo crew now has 20 people. Bigger ships did not bring bigger teams.
